Package com.nexuslink.core.connection

Class ConnectionStore

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.connection.ConnectionStore
public final class ConnectionStore extends Object
Persists the user's saved connections (and which bundled samples they've hidden) to ~/.nexuslink/connections.json, so connections can be cached and reopened across runs. Secrets themselves belong in the credential vault; profiles store references, not plaintext.
